reviews.recommendation: Ultra-fast MiniMax H3 reference-to-video: about 72 seconds claimed on a 4090 versus the current 7:30 H3 lane. The 16GB VRAM fit is promising, not proven.
cherryPick: 4-step turbo LoRA + VSA sparse-attention pattern for H3
Ref2VA gate-transplant technique preserves the multimodal identity prefix
reviews.gradingSummary: High-value experiment with a clear benchmark and measurable upside.
reviews.cursorBrief:
TEST: ComfyUI-Ref2VA-VSA on the H3 lane (side install only)

GOAL: Test whether Kablex/ComfyUI-Ref2VA-VSA (ultra-fast MiniMax H3 reference-to-video, ~72s claimed on 4090) runs on Vader's 16GB 5060 Ti and beats our current H3 lane (~7:30/gate), with acceptable character hold.

SOURCE: https://github.com/Kablex/ComfyUI-Ref2VA-VSA — the README is the source of truth for requirements, checkpoint URLs, and node wiring. Follow it.

SCOPE — HARD BOUNDARIES:
- Side install ONLY: ComfyUI 0.37.0 on :8189. Do NOT touch production 0.31.0 (:8188), do NOT modify any existing workflows, additive work only.
- No git commits or pushes anywhere without Jon's explicit go.
- Test-only. No license decisions, no commercial use — H3's community license (US excluded) is unchanged.

STEPS:
1. Clone the repo into the SIDE install's custom_nodes dir and restart it. Verify the node appears: FastH3/VSA -> Ref2VA VSA Gate Transplant (EXPERIMENTAL).
2. Check for comfy-kitchen with CUDA sol_attn support (a hard requirement). If missing, install it and note exactly what you added.
3. Download the 6 checkpoints into the side install's models/ dirs (filenames + destinations + HF links are in the README's Requirements table):
   - diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
   - loras/fasth3_vsa_gate.safetensors
   - loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
   - text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
   - vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors + vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
4. Load the repo's workflows/ref2va_vsa_4step_rtx4090.json and run it with the bundled example_character.jpg (apples-to-apples with the author's benchmark).
5. Watch VRAM: author measured ~13.5GB peak on a 4090 but specs 24GB. We have 16GB. If it OOMs, do NOT force it — report the OOM and stop.

REPORT BACK (bridge inbox note, structured template, ends with DONE + JON OWES):
- Wall time: first run AND warm run, for the 5s / 24fps / 1344x768 output
- Peak VRAM observed (nvidia-smi)
- Steps/sampler actually used, and whether the 4-step turbo path engaged
- Character-hold verdict: 1-5 plus one line on whether the character stays on-model
- Head-to-head vs our current H3 lane (7:30/gate): faster? by how much? quality trade-off?
- Your recommendation: adopt for the H3 lane, park it, or kill it — with the reason in one sentence

DONE = benchmark numbers + hold verdict + adopt/park/kill recommendation are in the bridge note.
